messages:
nina: heads-up: we hit an ugly issue consuming the JS SDK in an edge-targeted build. named import is undefined only after rollup/vite prebundle. local node run is fine.

max: ah that sounds like the commonjs -> esm wrapper problem. share minimal repro?

nina: gist with repro here: https://gist.github.com/nina/edge-repro. summary: app has `type: 'module'`, imports `import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference'`. when built with rollup + @rollup/plugin-commonjs (output: es) and then deployed via Vite SSR, runtime prints `RedwoodClient undefined`.

lila: quick check: what's the package.json of the sdk look like? main/module/exports?

nina: sdk package.json: "main":"dist/cjs/index.js","module":"dist/esm/index.js","exports":{"import":"./dist/esm/index.js","require":"./dist/cjs/index.js"},"types":"dist/types/index.d.ts". cjs sets `exports.RedwoodClient = RedwoodClient`. esm does `export class RedwoodClient {}`.

max: yep, that mismatch is a classic. esbuild (vite optimizeDeps) sometimes prefers the require path and shims it to `export default { RedwoodClient: ... }`, so your `import { RedwoodClient }` winds up undefined.

lila: app-side quick fixes: 1) force the ESM entry with `import('@redwood/inference/dist/esm/index.js')`, 2) in vite.config `ssr: { noExternal: ['@redwood/inference'] }`, or 3) webpack: set `resolve.mainFields` to `['module','main']`. all ugly but stop the crash.

nina: types are annoying too: switching to default import fixes runtime but TS then complains `Module has no default export`.

max: ask SDK team to: publish a true ESM build with named exports, add a default export that mirrors the named one, include d.ts that exports both named and default, and add an `exports` map for "." with import/require and types under import. also add bundler smoke tests (rollup + vite-ssr + webpack).

lila: temporary safe loader for edge stacks: `const m = await import('@redwood/inference'); const Client = m.RedwoodClient || m.default?.RedwoodClient || m.default;` then `new Client()` — avoids crash while waiting for publish.

devex-bot: Reminder: SDK triage at 3pm. drop the repro link in the issue and tag `sdk-maintainers`.

nina: filing issue now with repro and suggested publish patch. will ping here when there's a fix.
